subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a public configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed newline insertion, but a configurable preference would add public TUI config or CLI surface under a repository policy that sets a high bar for new config.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define and test a narrow TUI keybinding config or CLI surface for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Editor Backlog
options.body: Route configurable send keys into the broader TUI keybinding/editor backlog with external-editor and vi-mode decisions.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-Enter fallback in docs and /help while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this issue and have the strongest current TUI/docs routing signal from the available history.
